depth_targets.title: Observability Analytics (query builder + a SQL subset over log entries)
limitations: SQL mode supports a subset of BigQuery SQL (SELECT/WHERE/ORDER BY/LIMIT over one bucket's entries) — no joins, subqueries or real BigQuery billing/slots.

depth_targets.title: Previous/month-to-date usage counters on the metrics list
limitations: Usage is the live count of stored log entries matching the metric's filter in the current/previous calendar month, not GCP's billed-bytes accounting.

depth_targets.title: Router volume + volume by destination type
limitations: Volume is the live count/bytes of entries each enabled sink's filter matched as they were written, not a historical GCP billing export.

depth_targets.title: Create usage alert / View usage data (Monitoring-backed storage alerting)
limitations: Storage usage alerting hands off to Cloud Monitoring alert policies, which Vyomi's Logging lens does not model; the console shows this honestly rather than faking an alert that never fires.
